edits.headline: Tornadoes hit Sicily, injuring dozens and damaging buildings
edits.subheadline: Dozens of people were injured and buildings were damaged when tornadoes struck Sicily, the Guardian reported.
editorialBody: Tornadoes hit Sicily, injuring dozens of people and damaging buildings, the Guardian reported.
A wallet linked to the CryptoBilis thefts sent 464 ETH to the Tornado Cash mixer, The Defiant reported.
Women candidates could make history in the US midterm elections, DW News reported.
In the UK, the Green Party said it wants to make sure it is "not vulnerable to extremists", BBC News reported.

Russian President Vladimir Putin passed Iran's view on a possible resolution of the conflict to Donald Trump, the Kremlin said, according to TASS. Most of the Putin-Trump phone call was about a Ukraine settlement, a Kremlin spokesman said, TASS reported.
Hunger and malnutrition are spreading among Gazans a year after the ceasefire, AFP reported.

US truckers warned that rising diesel costs could have a "domino effect", Fox News reported. A new exchange-traded fund offers investors an all-or-nothing bet on the S&P 500 reaching 10,000, MarketWatch reported.
